description: This file contains the implementation of the PermissionService interface, providing business logic for managing permissions within a sales management application. It includes methods for retrieving, deleting, and modifying permissions, often interacting with data access objects and other services.

classes.name: PermissionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing permissions, extending the generic entity service and implementing the PermissionService interface, providing CRUD and permission management functionalities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a permission entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Intended to save a new permission or update an existing one (currently unimplemented).

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.description: Deletes a permission after nullifying its associated groups.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Fetches a list of permissions associated with given group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of permissions matching specified criteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a group from a permission’s group set.
